title: Reading Drill — Keeping track of school costumes — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Keeping track of school costumes — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The school wardrobe organiser in Ravensmere received an old report about costumes being loaned out while repairs are pending. The report compared the number of unusable returns, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the wardrobe logs rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered nine weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include unrecorded exchanges. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed repair tags visible from the shelf as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
